{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Count how many times -999.0 appears in biomarker_baseline
count_sentinel_baseline = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Count how many times -999.0 appears in biomarker_final
count_sentinel_final = (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == sentinel_value).sum()

print(f"Number of times -999.0 appears in biomarker_baseline: {count_sentinel_baseline}")
print(f"Number of times -999.0 appears in biomarker_final: {count_sentinel_final}")"}
